cells.gaps: The share of 90 per cent or more that stage 5 needs is not published: the finance ministry's all 176 local governments (UGA-022, October 2026) is IRAS rolled out, a share equipped, and the 166 in use (UGA-025, April 2025) is a count read against that total of 176 from another source. What IRAS records of payers is stated for the system (UGA-018, UGA-020), not for each local government; the Auditor General found skills, connectivity and device shortfalls in 30 sampled (UGA-016). The plan facet is none (UGA-006, 2024).
cells.note: IRAS keeps a register of 3.1 million taxpayers with bills, payments and arrears in a common database reporting to the centre (UGA-020, UGA-021, October 2026), and is in use in 166 of the country's 176 local governments (UGA-025): more than half, stage 4. Stage 5 needs 90 per cent or more on a published figure, and the only figure for all 176 is of rollout.
